style_guide.lighting: Soft natural light, indoor, warm white balance, 7-10am morning light, backlit when possible
style_guide.surface: Raw linen cloth, unfinished light wood, handmade ceramic plate, kraft paper — warm neutral tones matching #F7F2E6 / #FBF8F0
style_guide.composition: Centered or rule-of-thirds, 50-70% negative space, single subject per frame, shallow depth of field
style_guide.mood: Quiet, minimal, apothecary-meets-modern-kitchen, premium-accessible, Indian metro morning ritual
style_guide.avoid: Stock photography energy, mystic/temple imagery, saffron-orange decoration, marble, gold, luxury-aspirational, before/after, harsh midday light, cool-blue cast

images.location: Homepage hero — right card (collection explore card, 3 product placeholders)
images.note: This card has 3 separate ProductPlaceholder slots (coffee 3:4, shilajit 1:1, brahmi 5:6). Generate 3 individual product shots on transparent/neutral background that work as a grouped trio.

images.dimensions: Square 1:1 ratio, ~500x500px display area, product floats on dark background
images.prompt: A dark matte glass jar of adaptogenic coffee, floating against a deep brown-black background. Warm amber radial glow behind the jar. The jar has a cream paper label with lowercase serif branding. Dramatic studio lighting, single warm key light from above-right. Visible condensation or texture on the jar surface. Moody, premium, clean product shot. No other objects. Dark background matching #1A0F08 to #3D2415.

Adaptogenic coffee jar, dark matte glass with cream label, photographed from front-facing 3/4 angle on a warm peach-toned linen surface. A torn-open single-serve sachet beside it, coffee powder visible. Soft diffused natural light. Tight crop, product fills 60% of frame. Warm amber-cream color palette.

A small round glass jar with wooden cap containing dark shilajit resin. The jar sits on a raw stone slab or unfinished wood surface. A thin wooden spoon rests beside it with a small amount of dark resin. Soft morning light, earth tones, sage-green linen underneath. Minimal composition, apothecary feel. Product centered.

A small dark glass dropper bottle with cream label, containing golden-amber brahmi rasayana liquid. The dropper is pulled out slightly, showing the liquid. Placed on a pale lavender-tinted linen cloth. A single fresh green brahmi leaf beside the bottle, slightly out of focus. Soft diffused light. Muted indigo-violet and cream tones. Clean, clinical-botanical feel.

A dark matte glass bottle of ashwagandha tablets with cream paper label. The bottle is slightly open, 3-4 round beige tablets scattered naturally on the surface beside it. Placed on a sage-green linen cloth over light wood. Soft natural light from the side. Earthy, grounded, clean composition. Olive-green and cream palette.

A wide-mouth glass jar with wooden lid containing fine brown-green triphala churna powder. A small brass measuring spoon rests on the rim. Placed on natural kraft paper over a sage-green linen. Warm side lighting, visible powder texture. A single dried amla fruit beside the jar, out of focus. Earthy, wholesome, apothecary aesthetic.

A dark glass bottle with cream label containing herbal supplement capsules. Bottle on a soft teal-tinted linen cloth. 2-3 translucent capsules placed beside it showing the herbal powder inside. A sprig of dried herb nearby. Soft window light, cool-warm balanced tones. Teal and cream palette. Clean, minimal, modern apothecary.
